content.text: The text combines an extensive medical index with excerpts from several works. The index covers diseases, symptoms, diagnoses, treatments, and remedies from pharyngitis through typhlitis. A comedy, *None So Deaf Who Won’t Hear*, follows deaf Mr. Coddle, his daughter Eglantine, servant Jane, and hunter Whitwell, whose mutual pretended deafness eventually leads to reconciliation and marriage plans. Other advertisements describe patriotic women’s plays. A novel excerpt follows Dagobert, Agricola, Gabriel, and Mother Bunch in Paris; Agricola leaves their garret in haste for Mademoiselle de Cardoville’s house. Adrienne lives in a pavilion at Saint-Dizier House and receives Agricola in her saloon, where he seeks aid for his family. She arranges clothing and travel for Prince Djalma from Cardoville Manor House to Paris.
